projects.name: PhoneCam Pro
projects.summary: Turns an Android phone or iPhone into a real Windows webcam — one that Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet detect as physical hardware. No DroidCam, no OBS, no third-party drivers.
projects.detail: The core is a DirectShow filter written from scratch in C++ that registers itself as a system camera device and pulls frames from shared memory. A Python server receives the phone's camera stream over WiFi or USB tethering and writes into that shared buffer. Supports live quality switching from 480p to 1080p, remote front/back camera flip, and automatic reconnection on network drop.

projects.name: SpaceMedic
projects.role: Offline Windows storage & memory analyser · MIT licensed
projects.summary: Answers two questions: what is using my disk and memory, and what can I safely reclaim. Built for developers whose machines quietly fill up with node_modules, virtual environments, build outputs, package caches, and AI model downloads.
projects.detail: Designed safety-first: read-only until the user explicitly selects something, deletions route through the Recycle Bin, and it will never touch Windows, System32, WinSxS, or pagefile.sys. Ships with 29 regression tests, an eight-language localisation framework, and a validated community rule system that rejects absolute paths and directory traversal. No telemetry, no account, no network calls.

projects.name: EarBridge NEXUS
projects.summary: Most Bluetooth earbuds pair with only one device at a time. EarBridge streams laptop audio to your phone over WiFi, where a web app plays it through the earbuds already connected there — so you hear both devices at once, with no extra hardware.
projects.detail: Uses the A2DP music profile rather than the low-quality HFP call profile, and runs playback on an AudioWorklet so it survives OS thread suspension when the browser is backgrounded. Includes an adaptive jitter buffer that measures live network jitter and retunes buffer depth, RTT-based signal quality monitoring, and per-client isolated send queues so one slow device never stalls the others.

projects.name: GitHub Project Publisher
projects.role: WPF application for safe repository publishing
projects.summary: A Windows desktop tool that publishes local projects to GitHub with validation built in — checking for secrets, oversized files, and missing metadata before anything reaches a public repository.
projects.detail: Structured as a proper .NET solution with a separate test project, CI workflow, installer build script, and dedicated security and validation documentation.
